data.description: A poltergeist has no method of attacking apart from its telekinesis.  This ability functions as the spell telekinesis, with a CL of %1.  A poltergeist has a ranged attack roll of +%1 when using telekinesis to hurl objects or creatures, and can use the ability on objects or creatures of up to %2 pounds.  If a poltergeist attempts to hurl a creature with this ability, that creature can resist the effect with a successful DC %3 Will save.
data.name: Telekinesis
